text:
maria: FYI — forecasting tool shows a ~45% short spike in EU GPU‑hours starting Tue 00:00 UTC, lasting ~36h. Needs autoscaler review.

samir: rough numbers? is that user growth or promo-driven?

maria: promo-driven (email + ad push). Projection attached: peak qps -> 3.2x baseline. cost hit if we keep current steady reserves :moneybag:

kai: thinking we should widen the smoothing window and increase regional reserve for EU. Current smoothing is 30s, reserve 15 gpus.

jen: +1 but curious about tail latency impact. If we smooth too hard we might oversubscribe and increase p99.

samir: agree. proposal: short-term (48h) bump reserve to 40 gpus in eu-west1, smoothing window 180s, scale_up_rate 2x, scale_down_delay 600s. Also allow 25% more preemptible mix.

io: quick sim on that? I can run a 24h replay on staging; should show p50/p95 changes. target: p95 < 200ms for gen endpoints.

prod-analytics: replay queued — ETA 18m. baseline replay shows cache hit @ 12%, so actual GPU token work might be higher than naive.

maria: also watch inter-region routing — if eu is saturated we want smart-fallback to us-east with preference for premium customers only.

kai: config snippet for canary:
```
region: eu-west1
reserve: 40
smoothing_window_sec: 180
scale_up_rate: 2.0
scale_down_delay_sec: 600
preemptible_mix_pct: 25
fallback_policy: route_non_sla_to_us
```

samir: thanks. opsbot — create incident ticket and tag oncall please

opsbot: created issue RED-2319 and assigned to eng-infra oncall (link: https://go/redwood/RED-2319)

jen: runbook note — if autoscaler thrashes, revert smoothing to 60s and drain reserve over 2h. I'll add to runbook.

maria: decision: apply the config as a staged rollout at Tue 00:00 UTC for 48h, monitor token cost & p95, rollback if p95 > 250ms or GPU spend > +70% forecast.

io: replay results: p95 predicted to be +30ms with proposed settings, cost +48% for window — within thresholds.

samir: I'm deploying canary now to eu-west1-c (10% traffic). Will update in 10m.

maria: thanks team. follow-ups: jen update runbook, io paste replay graphs in RED-2319, samir notify account execs if we need to extend.

prod-analytics: monitoring dashboards pinned to RED-2319. :chart_with_upwards_trend:

maria: closing thread, we'll debrief after 48h. :white_check_mark:
